purpose_context: A project carrying the older multi-file charter bundle is refused at the implement gate and told to run a command that cannot possibly fix it, while every other diagnostic reports the project healthy. The operator has no way out and no way to see why. This mission makes a gate's own remediation provably able to clear the check that emitted it, and gives 'does the charter exist' a single answer instead of two that disagree.
purpose_tldr: An operator blocked by the charter preflight gate can always follow its own advice to become unblocked, and every diagnostic agrees with the gate about whether the charter exists.
